attributes.title: 2027 TVMA Annual Conference & Expo
attributes.venue: Woodlands Waterway Marriott Hotel & Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The 2027 TVMA Annual Conference & Expo of the Texas Veterinary Medical Association is listed for March 5 to 7, 2027, in The Woodlands, Texas. The association pitches it to veterinarians at every career stage.

The meeting is at the Woodlands Waterway Marriott Hotel & Convention Center, where the TVMA room block is $229 a night if booked by February 5, 2027. Early-bird registration through January 31, 2027 is $480 for TVMA member veterinarians and $580 for non-member DVMs; LVTs, CVAs and hospital staff pay $260 as members or $360 otherwise, and on-site registration adds $50. The CE hour total is not stated on the conference pages yet.
